nodes.name: copywriting-formulas.md
nodes.summary: Copywriting formulas reference for slide creation covering 5 core formulas: PAS (Problem-Agitate-Solution), AIDA (Attention-Interest-Desire-Action), FAB (Features-Advantages-Benefits), Cost of Inaction, and Before-After-Bridge. Includes formula-to-slide mapping, headline patterns, power words, contrast patterns, social proof patterns, and search commands.

nodes.name: create.md
nodes.summary: Minimal slides creation task reference with single task heading.

nodes.name: html-template.md
nodes.summary: HTML slide template with base structure, Chart.js integration for charts, animation classes for transitions, background image handling, and CSS variables reference for building presentation slides.

nodes.name: layout-patterns.md
nodes.summary: Slide layout patterns reference with layout selection by use case, CSS structures for title slides, two-column splits, feature grids (3 columns), metrics dashboards (4 columns), component variants (card styles, metric styles), visual treatments, search commands, and layout decision flow.

nodes.name: slide-strategies.md
nodes.summary: Slide strategies reference with strategy selection guide, common structures (YC Seed Deck 10 slides, Sales Pitch 9 slides, Product Demo 6 slides), Duarte Sparkline pattern, search commands, and matching strategy to context guide.
